listing:
Private Student Suite — 381 King St N, Waterloo, ON (Jan 1 – Apr 30, 2027)

Clean furnished bedroom with private washroom in a 3-bed student apartment near WLU & UW. Rent: $1,050/month (utilities and Wi-Fi included). Landlord owns the building off-site (does not live here). In-person tours available Tuesday and Thursday evenings; email king381.mgmt@example.com to schedule.

Strict tenancy terms:
1. Upon signing, tenant must pay a rent deposit equal to two months' rent ($2,100) upfront.
2. The rent deposit earns zero interest and is strictly non-refundable under any circumstances.
3. Zero tolerance for late rent: if rent is more than 5 days overdue, management will immediately deactivate your smart-lock code and remove your belongings from the room without waiting on a Landlord and Tenant Board hearing.
label_rationale: Real local listing with viewing offered (not a fake-listing scam), but contains three severe RTA violations: (1) two months' rent deposit exceeds the one-month/one-period cap in Ontario RTA s. 106(2); (2) 'zero interest' and 'strictly non-refundable' violate s. 106(6) (mandatory annual interest at guideline rate) and s. 106(10) (must apply to last rent period); (3) disabling smart-lock access and removing belongings without an LTB order violates s. 24 (changing locks), s. 37(1), and s. 39 (recovery of possession only via LTB order). All void under s. 4(1). Under SPEC D6, HOLD.
